evidence: Start: Incident Report Summary - issues in us-central1 began 6 May 2022 at 01:30 Pacific. End: Mini Incident Report and status update - incident ended and resolved for affected projects at 12:06 Pacific. Regions: Summary and Detailed Impact - mostly zone us-central1-b, but some regional services degraded, Datastream across the whole region.
notes: Published date is the full Incident Report entry, 16 May 2022 16:12 PDT (23:12Z). Early status updates gave the start as 01:20 Pacific; the incident report and page header give 01:30, which is coded. Scope regional because several regional services in us-central1 degraded beyond zone b. BigQuery US multi-region also affected; not coded as a region. Bigtable had residual impact for a small share after 12:06. Services counted (15): BigQuery, Bigtable, Pub/Sub, Cloud Load Balancing, Compute Engine, Persistent Disk, Datastream, Filestore, Memorystore, Cloud SQL, GKE, Apigee, Dataflow, Data Fusion, Cloud Networking.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report - support center trouble began 28 April 2022 at 07:27 Pacific. End: Mini Incident Report - incident end given as 08:51 Pacific, about 84 minutes later. Regions: Mini Incident Report - location listed as Global.
notes: Published date is the Mini Incident Report entry on this page, 28 Apr 2022 18:22 PDT, which is 29 Apr 01:22 UTC; a later 5 May 2022 entry only links to a full report on another page. A status update says resolved as of 09:04 Pacific; the stated incident end 08:51 is coded. App Engine infrastructure overload is named as the cause, not as a customer-facing impaired service; only Google Cloud Support counted.

evidence: Start: Detailed Description of Impact - errors for Traffic Director users ran from 10:07 Pacific on 8 March 2022. End: Detailed Description of Impact - errors lasted until 12:42 Pacific, when forced reprogramming mitigated them. Regions: Mini report lists Global; a status update says impact seen only in us-east1 so far.
notes: 8 March 2022 falls before the 13 March 2022 DST change, so Pacific times are PST (UTC-8); the page labels these entries PST. Published date is the Incident Report entry, 15 Mar 2022 16:23 PDT (23:23Z). Scope global because the title says global and the location is Global; us-east1 coded because a status update names it as the only region where impact was observed. A status update gives the start to the second (10:07:51). Header lists Cloud Networking, Cloud Load Balancing, Traffic Director and VPC, but a later update says the issue was limited to Traffic Director users and the mini report lists only Traffic Director; counted 1.

evidence: Start: Detailed Description of Impact - products saw impact from 15:15 Pacific on Saturday 8 January 2022. End: Detailed Description of Impact - impact window closes at 18:36 Pacific, when all services were marked recovered. Regions: Summary and Root Cause - only zone us-west1-b affected; no other zone was at risk.
notes: Published date is the Updated Incident Report entry, 21 Jan 2022 07:56 PST (15:56Z); an earlier Incident Report was posted 19 Jan 2022. The mini report gives the start as 15:14 Pacific; the incident report impact window gives 15:15, which is coded. The network issue was mitigated at 18:00 Pacific, but the report's impact window runs to 18:36. Services counted (8): Cloud Router, Cloud VPN, Cloud DNS, Cloud AI prediction, Cloud Run, Cloud Spanner, Compute Engine, Persistent Disk; GKE instances are mentioned only as Compute Engine instances, and header entries Cloud Networking and Hybrid Connectivity are product groupings of these.

evidence: Start: Impact to Multiple Availability Zones - first regional API impact dated from 12:50 AM PDT on April 21. End: Recovering EBS - EBS API access in the affected zone returned at 6:15 PM PDT April 23. Regions: Overview and Primary Outage - one US East zone, with EBS API errors twice across the whole region.
notes: The faulty network change was made at 12:47 AM PDT, but the first stated customer impact time is 12:50 AM PDT; 12:50 coded. The affected Availability Zone is not named by code, so zones is empty. End chosen as API restoration in the affected zone (6:15 PM PDT April 23); by 3:35 PM PDT April 23 most remaining volumes were usable, the last 2.2% of volumes were restored manually into April 24, and 0.07% could not be restored. Services counted (3): EC2, EBS, RDS.

evidence: Start: Opening account - disruption began when ELB state data was deleted at 12:24 PM PST on December 24. End: Recovery account - nearly all affected load balancers fully working again by 10:30 AM PST December 25. Regions: Title and opening - event in the US-East Region.
notes: No publication date shown; the title gives only the event date and the text says earlier this week. At first only ELB API calls failed; running load balancers were degraded later, and at peak 6.8% were impacted. The team kept monitoring and announced normal operation at 12:05 PM PST December 25; the 10:30 AM substantial recovery is coded. Service counted: Elastic Load Balancing.

evidence: Start: Opening paragraph - SimpleDB unavailable to nearly all API calls from 9:16 PM PDT on June 13. End: Opening and recovery paragraphs - most APIs normal again at 11:16 PM PDT; domain create and delete throttled until 1:30 AM. Regions: Opening - disruption in the US East Region.
notes: No publication date shown. The report gives June 13 with no year, so start_utc and end_utc cannot be dated and are left empty; the stated window is 9:16 PM to 11:16 PM PDT (04:16Z to 06:16Z the next day), which would be impact_ended at minute precision, with elevated CreateDomain and DeleteDomain errors until 1:30 AM. Duration left empty because the report gives a start and end pair, not a length. Power loss hit one data center, but the service failed region-wide. Service counted: SimpleDB.

evidence: Start: Loss of Power - utility power failed at 10:25 PM PDT on June 4, cutting power to many instances. End: Recovery - by 1:00 AM PDT more than 80% of impacted instances and volumes were back. Regions: Opening and Recovery - one zone in the Sydney Region; instance launches failed until failover at 11:42 PM.
notes: No publication date shown; the text says only this past weekend. The report gives June 4 with no year, so start_utc and end_utc are left empty; stated start 10:25 PM PDT June 4 (05:25Z June 5) and most-customer recovery 1:00 AM PDT (08:00Z), which would be impact_ended at minute precision; power restored 11:46 PM PDT, DNS errors recovered 2:49 AM, nearly all instances by 8 AM. The affected Availability Zone is not named by code. Scope regional because launch and Auto Scaling API errors reached the unaffected zones until the 11:42 PM failover. Services counted (4): EC2, EBS, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing; zone-internal DNS failures counted under EC2. The page repeats the report body twice.

evidence: Start: Kinesis account - alarms for record put and get errors first fired at 5:15 AM PST. End: Kinesis account - Kinesis was fully back to normal at 10:23 PM PST. Regions: Title and opening - disruption in Northern Virginia, US-EAST-1.
notes: Published date is the date shown under the title (November 25th 2020), the same as the event date. The 2:44 AM PST capacity addition was the trigger, not a stated impact time. Kinesis end coded; CloudWatch metrics and alarms fully recovered at 10:31 PM PST, and later metric backfill is excluded. Services counted (9): Kinesis Data Streams, Cognito, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling, Lambda, CloudWatch Events, EventBridge, ECS, EKS; the Service Health Dashboard posting delay is internal and not counted.

evidence: Start: Opening paragraph - Direct Connect users saw packet loss and intermittent connectivity from 7:30 AM JST on September 2, 2021. End: Opening paragraph - connectivity problems fully cleared by 1:42 PM JST. Regions: Opening paragraph - traffic into the Tokyo Region hit; Direct Connect to other regions unaffected.
notes: No publication date shown; the title and text give only the event date. Times are given in JST (UTC+9), not PDT or PST, and are converted from JST. Customers began seeing recovery at 12:30 PM JST; full resolution at 1:42 PM JST is coded as the end. The page holds the report in Japanese and English, each twice. Service counted: AWS Direct Connect.
